description: Run or continue a Support Triage interview: classify the issue (incident / bug / enhancement / misconfiguration / new_feature), score it against that type's readiness rubric, resolve the likely owning team from the code graph, and return a paste-ready rendering plus the structured draft. Pass the SAME sessionId returned by a prior call to continue the SAME interview — the server owns the conversation, the caller only ever sends the newest message. Never files or writes anything; take `rendered` and file it wherever you actually track issues.

context.description: Optional background for the agent — an incident channel, a related ticket id, prior investigation notes.

externalUserRef.description: An opaque, stable reference for the END CUSTOMER this interview is for — your own id for them, never anything they supply. Keeps two of your customers' conversations in separate sessions even though both arrive on the same API key. Pass the SAME value on every call for the same person.

format.description: Rendering format for the paste-ready output. Defaults to markdown. Use adf for pasting into Jira Cloud.

repos.description: Repo full names (owner/name) known to be relevant, if any — improves ownership routing.

sessionId.description: The sessionId from a PRIOR call, to continue the same interview. Omit to start a new one.

text.description: The newest message in the interview — the initial problem description, or the answer to the agent's last follow-up question.

name: anyforge_triage_ticket
title: Triage ticket
